review.purpose: First step of end-to-end smoke: speech transcription, diarization, pitch-based voice hints, German and French speech translation; no dubbing in this stage
review.model: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3; Canary 1B v2; NeMo multilingual MarbleNet VAD and TitaNet large diarization
review.revision: Parakeet 541d1f99c6b0c3cd0b11a95167540bb8edefd82b; Canary d455706339a6b32e1aa40f82c713a482a0c938e2; NeMo VAD and TitaNet resolved by NeMo 2.5.3, revisions not pinned
review.precision: FP16 ASR and translation; diarization default precision
review.reason: Generate and test timestamped English transcription, speaker turns and German/French translation before CPU dubbing
review.input: new_guys/CRISPR is capable of more than we initially expected _ Jennifer Doudna_ Full Interview_720p_en-US_129kbps.mp4 first 15 seconds preflight and first 60 seconds smoke, 16kHz mono WAV; no full video
review.outputs: modal_control/batch_inputs/gpu_preflight.json and gpu_smoke.json; includes cues, speaker turns, pitch estimates and per-stage timings
review.quality_tradeoffs: Automatic translation and diarization can contain mistakes; pitch-based preset hints may be uncertain and do not establish gender; multiple speakers in excerpt are unverified
review.cost_estimate: Unknown actual cost; 1 T4 listed at $0.000164/sec plus 4 CPU, 32 GiB RAM and other applicable charges. Maximum two 1800-second stage deadlines implies at most $0.59 GPU time if both use a T4 throughout; CPU and RAM additional. Not a billing cap.
